fragments.text: BTW if we haven't done so already we should make the "staging" site a git checkout like futon7a so that we can always build on top of origin/master which is the public-facing live site

reply_text:
Done: staging is now built from a git checkout of the live site's repository. It's a worktree of futon7a at `~/code/futon7a-staging`, on a branch `staging` that starts from `origin/master`. Our drafts are commits on that branch, so publishing means merging it into master and pushing.

The old setup was already causing trouble. Staging copied whole draft files from `futon7/site-draft` over the live tree, and those copies had gone stale. Publishing them would have reverted two live fixes on the index page:
- the "chart like the one below" wording (live `01fdc9a`);
- the current `xiaoxiang-local.py` SHA-256. The draft still had the old checksum, so anyone checking the download would have seen a mismatch.

The draft 小象 page also differed from live by 141 lines from earlier publishes.

What I did:
- **Replayed the drafts.** The five unpublished draft commits are now on `staging`, on top of live:
  - the voxterm SVG figure;
  - the Elephant 2000 paragraph;
  - the memory section;
  - wholesale → bespoke;
  - the knowledge-work description.

  Compared with live, only those changes differ (`img/voxterm.svg`, 8 lines of `index.html`, 1 line of `xiaoxiang.html`). Both live fixes are intact.
- **Changed the build.** `stage-site.sh` now builds from the worktree (futon7 `a2f5bbf`). The DRAFT banner reads "staging ebcf068 …, 5 ahead of live". If live moves ahead, it also says how many commits staging is behind and to rebase before publishing.
- **Updated the watcher** (`hel-staging.path`) to the worktree and rebuilt staging. https://zone.hyperreal.enterprises/staging/ shows the bespoke section with the correct checksum.

Two things I haven't done:
- **Pushing the `staging` branch to hel.git.** I didn't push it, because I don't know whether the server deploys on any push. If it only deploys master, pushing `staging` would back it up. Tell me if that's safe.
- **Retiring `futon7/site-draft`.** Its HTML copies are now unused; the `.md` planning notes there are still useful. I can delete the HTML copies, or leave them with a README pointing to the worktree.

Publishing would be `git -C ~/code/futon7a merge --ff-only staging && git -C ~/code/futon7a push`. I'll wait for you to say go.
